command: cd /workspace; curl -s -m 20 https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500; echo ----; for p in usage credits billing cost; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -m 15 -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" "$MCPJAM_API_URL/$p" | head -c 600; echo; done; echo; curl -s -m 15 -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCPJAM_API_KEY" "$MCPJAM_API_URL/" | head -c 1000

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 20 https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | tail -c +5000 | grep -iE "cli|billing|credit|usage|plan|pricing|api|eval" | head -30; echo ----; curl -s -m 20 https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md | head -c 3500; which mcpjam npx

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 20 https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/reference.md | grep -iE -B1 -A3 "credit|usage|billing|cloud (evals|usage)|--cost|limit" | head -60; curl -s -m 20 https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md | grep -iE "MCPJAM_API|api-key|cloud " | head
cd /workspace; timeout 90 npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud --help 2>&1 | head -40; timeout 60 npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval list --project project_fixture 2>&1 | head -30
cd /workspace; C="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud"; $C orgs --help 2>&1 | sed -n 1,25p; $C whoami 2>&1|tail -5; $C eval run --help 2>&1 | sed -n 1,30p

cd /workspace; C="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud"; $C orgs list 2>&1|tail -5; $C eval run --project project_fixture --suite suite_fixture --server http://fixture:8765/mcp --idempotency-key trial-1 --wait --reporter json-summary --out /workspace/report.json 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cd /workspace; C="npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud"; $C eval run --project project_fixture --suite suite_fixture --server server_fixture --idempotency-key trial-1 --wait --reporter json-summary --out /workspace/report.json 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cd /workspace; npx -y @mcpjam/cli@latest cloud eval run --project project_fixture --suite suite_fixture --server server_fixture --idempotency-key trial-1 --wait --reporter json-summary --out /workspace/report.json 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; ls -la report.json; head -c 1500 report.json
